review_protocol: Codex-assisted developer semantic source-support review. Inspect complete rendered facts and interpretations; open evidence-seeking questions may pass, but an unsupported established premise or incorrect regimen fails. No independent human or clinical adjudication.

dev-01-agent.reviewer: Codex-assisted developer source-support review; no independent human or clinical adjudication
dev-01-agent.notes: Selects the June endometrial event and its linked study; rendered fields preserve adult advanced/recurrent disease, chemotherapy sequence and both biomarker cohorts. No unsupported comparative outcome.

dev-01-baseline.reviewer: Codex-assisted developer source-support review; no independent human or clinical adjudication
dev-01-baseline.notes: Correct event and trial, but claims expansion into earlier treatment lines without evidence about the prior label or comparator treatment line in this corpus.
